value.rationale: The theorem answers whether a complete critical excitation clock can arise dynamically rather than only exist initially, proving an all-graph non-nucleation law. The exact ambient inverse-fiber count for any clock is a structural tool that turns periodic-state enumerations into rigorous full-basin probabilities at threshold half-degree. The subcritical six-vertex witness establishes a sharp change in one-step ancestry, showing the obstruction depends on contact saturation rather than automatic color rotation.
